fieldValues.title: keyword-register keyed by paragraph, not field offset
fieldValues.summary: check-spec-language.mjs's keyword-register rule keyed each allowlist site by digest(keyword:charIndex), the match's character offset into the whole field. Any edit earlier in a grandfathered field shifted every later keyword's offset, re-firing every downstream allowlist entry on prose nobody touched (39 sites from one edit in 07-7-ext-views-l2, 4 in 07-19-ext-slices). Rekeyed by digest(paragraphText:keyword:ordinalWithinParagraph), the same unit em-dash-cap already uses, so only an edit to the paragraph itself changes its sites. --seed migrated the existing 588 entries with no net count change.
fieldValues.body: Reproduced the bug live before fixing: with the pre-fix code, inserting one word near the start of 07-7-ext-views-l2.json's content field (before its first RFC-2119 keyword) re-fired 24 keyword-register violations that the edit did not touch. Reverted, applied the paragraph-relative keying fix + --seed, repeated the identical edit: zero re-fires, still 588 grandfathered sites. Confirmed the fix does not blind the rule: a genuinely new MUST in a fresh paragraph still fails the check. Both gates (validate-all.mjs, check-release-drift.mjs) pass by exit code on the final diff. PR #641.
